examples.en: We need a metric to measure success.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个衡量成功的标准。

definitions.en: n. a standard by which something can be measured or judged
definitions.zh: [计] 基准程序; 基准

examples.en: This test is a benchmark for performance.
examples.zh: 这个测试是性能的基准。

examples.en: We set a benchmark for quality control.
examples.zh: 我们为质量控制设定了一个基准。

definitions.en: v. consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning
definitions.zh: vt. 分析, 细察, 分解

definitions.en: v. make a mathematical, chemical, or grammatical analysis of; break down into components or essential features
definitions.zh: [机] 分析

examples.en: We need to analyze the data carefully.
examples.zh: 我们需要仔细分析数据。

examples.en: Scientists analyze samples in the lab.
examples.zh: 科学家在实验室分析样本。

definitions.en: a. having a capacity for adaptation
definitions.zh: a. 适应的, 能适应的

examples.en: Adaptive systems can change with the environment.
examples.zh: 自适应系统可以随环境变化。

examples.en: She is very adaptive to new situations.
examples.zh: 她非常适应新环境。

definitions.zh: [电] 资料组

examples.en: The dataset contains thousands of images.
examples.zh: 这个数据集包含数千张图像。

examples.en: We used a large dataset for training.
examples.zh: 我们使用了一个大型数据集进行训练。

definitions.en: v. teach new skills
definitions.zh: vt. 重新训练, 再训练

examples.en: Workers need to retrain for new jobs.
examples.zh: 工人需要为新工作重新培训。

examples.en: The model must retrain with new data.
examples.zh: 这个模型必须用新数据重新训练。

definitions.en: v. make optimal; get the most out of; use best
definitions.zh: vt. 使完美, 使完善, 充分利用, 乐观地对待, 优化

definitions.en: v. modify to achieve maximum efficiency in storage capacity or time or cost
definitions.zh: vi. 持乐观态度

definitions.en: v. act as an optimist and take a sunny view of the world
definitions.zh: [计] 优化

examples.en: We can optimize the code for speed.
examples.zh: 我们可以优化代码以提高速度。

examples.en: The goal is to optimize resource usage.
examples.zh: 目标是优化资源使用。

definitions.en: n progress (or rate of progress) in work being done
definitions.zh: 工作流程

examples.en: The new software improves our workflow.
examples.zh: 新软件改进了我们的工作流程。

examples.en: We need to streamline the workflow process.
examples.zh: 我们需要简化工作流程。

definitions.en: n. botfly larva; typically develops inside the body of a horse or sheep or human
definitions.zh: [计] 磁带开始标志, 计算机角色
[医] 肤蝇[类]幼虫

examples.en: The bot answered all my questions quickly.
examples.zh: 机器人快速回答了我所有的问题。

examples.en: A bot can automate repetitive tasks online.
examples.zh: 机器人可以自动化在线重复任务。
